maria: Pen test report dropped to drive and evidence bucket. P1s need owners by EOD tomorrow. Please add remediation shortnotes in sheet.

nina: I'll own finding 1 (unencrypted backup key). Plan: rotate key, update vault secret, and add key policy deny for non-VPC. PR by 18:00.

rajeev: I'll handle ephemeral assessor role. Propose 1h STS role with MFA and require `RequestTag/assessor=true` so CloudTrail filters. Will include assume-role audit export.

maria: Good. Ensure CloudTrail + KMS logs exported for retest window and sha256 of bundle published.

security-bot: Run `scripts/evidence/gather.sh --from 2025-02-10 --to 2025-02-12` after fixes. Name bundles `pt-<ts>-<id>.tgz`.

oncall: Reserving retest slot Thu 09:00-13:00 UTC and will stand by. Freeze infra 60m before.

nina: Note — rotating key touches Airflow DAGs, pinging @data in the sheet. We'll canary to one worker.

maria: Deadline reminder: owners + PR links by EOD. Sitrep 09:30 PT tomorrow. Tag me in sheet when you claim ownership.
